title: Reroute the Mirror Lake Sanctum: Warden Duel
description: Reroute the Mirror Lake Sanctum: Warden Duel is a rebuilt Mythos Gates mission beat for Torii-Moon Mirror Road through The Torii-Moon Gate (Distortion Gate with ritual rerouting). One selected deity from Amaterasu, Tsukuyomi, Susanoo, Izanami enters; this beat spotlights Susanoo as the reference silhouette while preserving player choice. The mission is the elite step at Mirror Lake Sanctum, using shrine-road labyrinth and mirror sanctum pacing so shrine, treasure, hazard, elite, and boss reads are route-specific as a finished Mythos Gates campaign beat. Appearance rule: The Sacred Kingdoms is the source culture behind later mortal myth echoes; terrain, relics, enemy silhouettes, and rewards must use torii silhouettes, shrine lacquer red, white paper shide, braided shimenawa cords, mirror discs, foxfire blue, ink-wash smoke, cedar bark, moonlit silk, oni iron, tengu feather wind, dragon-rain scales, mask geometry, seasonal petals and ash..
lore: Ascension canon route rewrite: Torii-Moon Mirror Road is not a simple portal and not mortal apotheosis. It is a living Mythos Gate route where restored gods and goddesses answer Realm law under Hollow pressure. This mission advances Mirror Lake Sanctum and reveals: How foxfire copies allied silhouettes. No armies, squads, or simultaneous party bodies enter standard combat; the route is balanced around one active deity versus many enemies.
